```{python}
#| label: Setup
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
import datetime as dt
import utils as u

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Update between these lines

# First date
date = "2025-11-30"

# First Respond & Acclaim page pairs (psalm and acclamation)
RA = [4, 5]

# Number of first liturgical week
litweek = 1

# Liturgical season
season = 'Advent'

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
date = dt.datetime.strptime(date, "%Y-%m-%d")
```

All hymns are taken from the blue *Gather* hymnal unless otherwise noted. “R&A” indicates *Respond and Acclaim*. Christmas season Mass parts will be provided as handouts. Click on any title to listen to a recording for rehearsal purposes, but note that the lyrics may not match our hymnal. Please practice the lyrics in the *Gather* hymnal, regardless of the video.

::: {.callout-important title="Take heed!"}
The Mass setting changes for Advent, the Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception, and Christmas.
:::

```{python}
#| classes: no-stripe
#| label: 2025-11-30

psalm_ra_url = "https://youtu.be/4yPHj2DFoC4?list=PL1_lMtcpfrcloo19ceGJAEXPuXK2LS4os"
gaccl_ra_url = "https://youtu.be/6JGogB_Mb-I?list=PL1_lMtcpfrcloo19ceGJAEXPuXK2LS4os"

u.simple_table(hymns={

    "Processional":         "577 - Sing Out, Earth and Skies!",
    "Responsorial Psalm":   psalm_ra_url,
    "Gospel Acclamation":   gaccl_ra_url,
    "Preparation of Gifts": "443 - Awake! Awake, and Greet the New Morn",
    "Communion":            "397 - Maranatha, Lord Messiah",
    "Recessional":          "766 - City of God"

}, RA=RA, mass='[Missa Emmanuel](#missa-emmanuel)')
```

```{python}
date += dt.timedelta(days=7)
litweek += 1
RA = [i+2 for i in RA]
```

::: {.titlered}
### &nbsp;&#x2720; Mass Settings
:::

### Missa Emmanuel

- *Gloria is omitted during Advent.*
- 358 - `{python} u.md("Missa Emmanuel: Holy")`
- 359 - `{python} u.md("Missa Emmanuel: Memorial Acclamation A")` (*"We proclaim..."*)
- 360 - `{python} u.md("Missa Emmanuel: Amen")`
- NA - `{python} u.md("Missa Emmanuel: Lamb of God")`

### Heritage Mass

- Handout - `{python} u.md("Heritage Mass: Holy")`
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Heritage Mass: Memorial Acclamation A")` (*"We proclaim..."*)
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Heritage Mass: Amen")`
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Heritage Mass: Lamb of God")`

### Christmas Carol Mass

- Handout - `{python} u.md("A Christmas Gloria")` (by Paul Gibson)
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Christmas Carol Mass: Holy")`
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Christmas Carol Mass: Memorial Acclamation C")` (*"Save us, Savior..."*)
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Christmas Carol Mass: Amen")`
- Handout - `{python} u.md("Christmas Carol Mass: Lamb of God")`
